National Pecan Cookie Day is a food holiday celebrated each year on September 2lst in the United States. The day is dedicated to honoring and enjoying pecan cookies, a popular treat made with pecans, which are a native nut to North America. Pecan cookies come in many variations, such as classic drop cookies, pecan sandies, butter pecan cookies, and shortbreads with chopped or whole pecans. Pecans provide a rich, buttery flavor and crunchy texture to desserts.
How it's celebrated:
People bake pecan cookies, share them with friends and family, or purchase them from bakeries and stores. Many share photos and recipes on social media using the hashtag #NationalPecanCookieDay.

It appears one of the big initial Ternus pushes will be more comprehensively integrating generative AI into Apple’s products, following the slow deployment under Cook. It’s most visible in a series of new features for the Apple Watch that record everything said around it to recognize sounds and music, provide a recap of your conversations, and allow a “Live Rewind” where you can see a transcript of what was said around you in the past 15 seconds.

At a moment of people freaking out about Meta’s “pervert glasses,” this is Apple moving to make the fear of your devices listening to everything you say a reality that’s openly championed as a new feature. The company is promising it will all be done in a way that respects privacy and security, but that’s what companies always say as we experience a progressive degradation in those very things.
